description: This file defines the class 'LoanApplicationTerms', which encapsulates the parameters, interest calculations, repayment schedule details, and various configurations related to loan application terms in the Fineract platform. It provides methods to assemble instances from different data models, perform interest and principal calculations, and manage loan schedule configurations.
